$comment: Individual income tax parameters. Draft values pending reconciliation against the research pass — see confidence flags.

legalBasis: NIRC Sec 24(A)(2)(a), as amended by RA 10963 (TRAIN) — rates effective Jan 1, 2023 onward
graduatedBrackets.notes: Base is the tax on the bracket floor; rate applies to the excess over the floor.

legalBasis: NIRC Sec 24(A)(2)(b), as amended by RA 10963
eightPercent.notes: In lieu of both graduated income tax and the Sec 116 percentage tax. Unavailable to VAT-registered taxpayers, those over the ₱3M threshold, those subject to other percentage taxes, and GPP partners. Mixed-income earners get no extra ₱250,000 reduction on the business side — it is embedded in the graduated computation of their compensation income.

legalBasis: NIRC Sec 34(L), as amended by RA 9504
osd.notes: For individuals, OSD is 40% of gross sales/receipts (corporations compute it on gross income instead). Election is irrevocable for the taxable year.

legalBasis: NIRC Sec 32(B)(7)(e), as amended by RA 10963
thirteenthMonthExclusionCap.notes: 13th month pay and other benefits excluded from gross income up to ₱90,000 per year.

legalBasis: NIRC Sec 56(A)(2), as amended by RA 10963
annualITRInstallment.notes: When annual income tax due exceeds ₱2,000, individuals may pay in two equal installments — at filing, and on or before October 15.

legalBasis: NIRC Sec 232, as amended by RA 11976 (EOPT)
afsRequiredAboveGross.notes: Books audited by an independent CPA required when gross annual sales exceed ₱3,000,000 (EOPT raised the old ₱150,000/quarterly threshold).
